name: A Swift Message
summary: Quartermaster Lewis needs armor for Westfall's militia, and he sends an urgent note to Stormwind by gryphon. With little help from the kingdom's forces, he asks you to take the requisition to Thor at Sentinel Hill for the flight to the capital.

sections.title: A Plea Across the Skies
sections.body: At Sentinel Hill, the People's Militia faces Defias outlaws and gnolls with little help from Stormwind's forces. Quartermaster Lewis relies on private contacts in the capital for weapons and armor. As the militia's supplies run low, he turns to Osric Strang, an armorer in Old Town. Lewis asks travelers to carry the urgent requisition note to Thor, Westfall's gryphon master.

sections.title: The Flight Network
sections.body: Gryphons carry people and messages swiftly across the Kingdom of Stormwind. Thor manages the air route to the capital from Sentinel Hill. When you give him Lewis's note, he carries the requisition to Stormwind by air. This route links Westfall's frontier garrison to the capital despite the lack of official aid.

faq.q: Why does Quartermaster Lewis need to send a note to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind gives Westfall little direct military aid, and the People's Militia is running low on armor. Lewis sends a requisition to Osric Strang, a trusted armorer in the city, to secure supplies.
Osric Strang is an armorer in Old Town, Stormwind, whose shop is called Limited Immunity. He supplies Lewis privately when official channels fail.
Thor is the gryphon master at Sentinel Hill. He carries Lewis's note between Westfall and Stormwind, and manages the gryphon flights connecting them.

faq.q: Why isn't Stormwind sending soldiers and gear to Westfall directly?
faq.answer: King Varian Wrynn is missing, and Stormwind's resources are stretched thin. Its leaders have largely neglected the outlying farmlands, leaving places like Sentinel Hill to rely on volunteer militias and private arrangements.

faq.q: Can any adventurer undertake this task?
faq.answer: Human adventurers who have proved themselves in Westfall are entrusted with this work. It introduces the kingdom's gryphon routes.

faq.q: Where does this courier mission lead next?
faq.answer: After you present the note to Thor, he prepares a gryphon flight to Stormwind. You land at the capital's gryphon roost, then seek Osric Strang in Old Town.

angles.text: As a human of the kingdom, you carry Lewis's note while Stormwind's provinces are under strain. You also learn the gryphon routes linking the kingdom's territories.
As an Alliance member, you see the strain between Stormwind's capital and the frontier outposts struggling in Westfall.
